content.short: Coin Parliament is a transparent social game that offers real rewards for voting.
content.description: Coin Parliament is a vote-to-earn game built on blockchain where players mint NFTs and earn rewards by casting votes. The experience is powered by decentralized technology, delivering a dynamic and rewarding journey for participants. Players collect unique cards and Collectibles, progress through influencer levels, and earn lifetime royalties as they participate. The game blends strategy, collection, and participation into an adventurous path toward prosperity.
